class.name: SkaldError
class.description: Indicates an error occurred during script parsing or execution. .code: int .message: string .line_number: int

members.member: The error code. Match against the [code]ERROR_*[/code] constants, e.g. [code]if err.code == SkaldError.ERROR_TYPE_MISMATCH[/code].
The line number where the error occurred.

constants.constant: The engine ran past the end of the module.
The loaded module has no content.
No block with the requested tag exists in the module.
[method SkaldEngine.act] was called with an index outside the option group.
The selected option's availability condition is false.
The engine is waiting on [method SkaldEngine.answer] for an open query.
[method SkaldEngine.answer] was called with no query pending.
A value's type does not match its declaration.
A referenced variable is not defined in any scope.
[method SkaldEngine.act] was called when no response was awaiting action.
A module failed to load (e.g. a [code]GO[/code] target could not be read).
The requested global is not declared in the codex.
An internal index was out of bounds.
[method SkaldEngine.start_at] targeted a block with no members.
